title: Irreversibility Scoring: Training a Lightweight Classifier to Flag High-Consequence Agent Actions Before Execution

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly addresses an open control problem. A deployable reversibility classifier is a concrete step toward runtime guardrails. Clear chain from labeled data to classifier to deployment in agentic systems.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Creating a labeled dataset of 300 actions and fine-tuning distilbert is well within beginner capabilities with mentorship. HuggingFace fine-tuning tutorials abound. GPT-4o zero-shot baseline comparison is trivial via API.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear single deliverable: a trained classifier with evaluation metrics. Dataset creation (300 examples), fine-tuning, and evaluation can fit in 30 hours. Generalization testing is a nice-to-have that can be scoped down.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
